macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks near record highs after cooler inflation data and lower Fed-hike odds
items.summary: U.S. equities extended a strong week as cooler inflation readings eased pressure on the Federal Reserve, with the S&P 500 closing at a record and the Dow and Nasdaq also posting gains earlier in the session. Fed funds futures shifted to about a 35% chance of a September hike, down from 40% the prior day and 55% a week earlier.[15][11][13]

items.title: Wall Street opens softer as the Dow dips, but major indexes remain set for a winning week
items.summary: MarketWatch reported a muted U.S. open with the Dow lower, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq were still on track to finish the week higher. That tone suggests investors are pausing after the recent inflation-driven rally rather than reversing it.[1]

items.title: U.S. PPI unexpectedly flat, reinforcing expectations that the Fed can stay on hold
items.summary: Producer prices were unchanged in July, which led traders to further reduce bets on a September Federal Reserve rate hike. Reuters reported that futures pricing for a September hike fell to 35% from 40% the previous day and 55% a week earlier.[11]

items.title: U.S. inflation cooled for a second month, supporting risk assets
items.summary: July CPI rose 3.4% year over year, while core inflation slowed to 2.5%, easing fears of further tightening. Reuters-based coverage noted that this helped push stocks higher and bond yields lower.[4][12][13]
items.source: CNN Business / Fox Business / NDTV Profit

items.title: Treasury yields and the dollar eased as disinflation data improved market sentiment
items.summary: Bond yields fell after the inflation data, with the 10-year Treasury yield down about five basis points in one market recap, while the dollar was little changed to mixed against major peers. The move reflected reduced pressure for an imminent Fed hike.[13][11]

items.title: India: rupee edges higher and policy focus stays on the RBI outlook
items.summary: The rupee gained 3 paise to close at 95.42 per U.S. dollar in a narrow range, while markets continue to expect the Reserve Bank of India to hold its repo rate at 5.25%. Local coverage also highlighted weak services PMI data and an RBI meeting watched for inflation and liquidity guidance.[7][3]

items.title: India: wholesale inflation eases, but equities end the week lower on crude and geopolitical worries
items.summary: Wholesale inflation moderated to 9.78% in July, but The Hindu BusinessLine said the Nifty finished the week in the red as Iran tensions and higher crude prices weighed on sentiment. The combination points to inflation relief that has not yet translated into stronger equity performance.[8]

items.title: Global markets mixed as U.S. inflation optimism is offset by geopolitical risk and selective earnings focus
items.summary: Global equities were mixed, with European markets broadly steady and Asia uneven, as investors balanced softer U.S. inflation against Middle East tensions. Bloomberg’s live coverage also noted that investors were watching company-specific earnings, including GB Group after it cut its revenue growth target.[16][18]

items.title: U.S. consumer sentiment weakens even as markets focus on inflation relief
items.summary: Yahoo Finance highlighted that economic optimism fell for the first time in three months, with Republican sentiment nearing a two-year low. That suggests household sentiment is lagging the recent market rally and cooler inflation backdrop.[10]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and major altcoins trade mostly lower near $63K amid weak liquidity
items.summary: Bitcoin hovered around $62.8K to $63.4K over the past day, with sources describing a modest decline and weak spot demand. Ethereum traded near $1.88K, while Solana, XRP, BNB, and other large caps were also slightly lower in a generally cautious market.

items.title: Selective altcoins post strong gains, led by ETHFI and ATOM
items.summary: Among the day’s notable movers, ether.fi (ETHFI) rose roughly 11% to 15% and Cosmos (ATOM) gained more than 10%, while other tokens such as AKEDO and Humanity also posted sharp one-day rallies. These moves stood out against the relatively muted action in Bitcoin and the broader market.

items.title: SEC cancels crypto capital-raising rules vote as regulatory delays weigh on the market
items.summary: A planned SEC meeting to vote on new crypto capital-raising rules was abruptly canceled, and multiple reports said broader U.S. crypto rulemaking efforts—including an innovation exemption and fundraising rules for token projects—have been delayed. Market coverage said the delays added pressure to Bitcoin and XRP.

items.title: Binance to restrict transactions involving HTX and 10 other platforms
items.summary: Binance said it will halt transaction processing for HTX and 10 additional cryptocurrency trading platforms beginning August 23. The move is one of the clearest exchange-related developments in the past 24 hours and could affect user flows across those venues.

items.title: Portugal orders Polymarket to shut down
items.summary: Portugal reportedly ordered prediction market platform Polymarket to shut down, adding to a wave of regulatory scrutiny affecting crypto-adjacent markets. The news underscores continued pressure on on-chain betting and prediction platforms.

items.title: Bitcoin developers use AI tools to uncover thousands of security vulnerabilities
items.summary: Forbes reported that Bitcoin developers used AI tools to identify nearly 5,000 security vulnerabilities across almost 400 projects in a 24-hour period. The report highlights growing use of AI in blockchain security audits and code review.

items.title: Upbit delisting puts JASMY, STORJ and TT under pressure
items.summary: Upbit’s delisting move has placed JASMY, STORJ, and TT under selling pressure, according to crypto news coverage. Delistings on major exchanges often trigger rapid liquidity and price impacts for affected tokens.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds from a selloff after softer U.S. inflation data
items.summary: Several market reports said Bitcoin briefly rebounded after U.S. inflation data came in softer than expected, easing Federal Reserve rate fears and improving risk sentiment. Even so, the market remained cautious as ETF outflows and regulatory uncertainty persisted.

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Google Gemini reaches 1 billion users
items.summary: Google's Gemini AI assistant reportedly reached one billion users, underscoring continued consumer-scale adoption of generative AI products. The development points to Gemini’s growing role in Google’s broader AI ecosystem.

items.title: OpenAI previews Ultrafast mode for GPT-5.6 Sol
items.summary: OpenAI introduced a preview of 'Ultrafast,' a faster mode for GPT-5.6 Sol that the company says can run up to 14 times faster. The release is aimed at enterprise users that need lower latency for agentic workflows.

items.title: IBM partners with OpenAI on enterprise AI
items.summary: IBM announced a partnership with OpenAI to expand enterprise AI adoption, including training and certification efforts for tens of thousands of consultants. The deal signals deeper integration of frontier models into corporate software and services.

items.title: Writer launches new AI model and lower-cost token harness
items.summary: Writer introduced a new AI model built as a post-training variation on Z.ai's open-source GLM-5.2, alongside an upgraded harness designed to reduce token costs. The company is positioning the release around deployment-ready enterprise performance at lower expense.

items.title: Anthropic adds invisible watermarks to Claude outputs
items.summary: Anthropic will add invisible watermarks to text and image outputs generated by Claude models, citing compliance with the EU AI Act. The change will apply globally, not just in Europe.

items.title: OpenAI pauses work on a model over cybersecurity risks
items.summary: OpenAI reportedly paused work on an AI model after identifying serious cybersecurity risks. The move highlights continued concern about frontier-model misuse and safety evaluation.

items.title: Microsoft sidelines Clippy-like Copilot character Mico
items.summary: Microsoft has reportedly removed 'Mico,' its Clippy-like Copilot character, from the Copilot Voice experience and moved it to Learn Live. The change suggests Microsoft is still refining the consumer-facing Copilot interface.

items.title: DeepSeek releases official V4 Pro model and raises API prices
items.summary: DeepSeek released its V4-Pro-0813 model, saying it improves agent capabilities and is available via API, app, and web. The company also said it will increase API prices and add peak and off-peak pricing.

items.title: Zhipu launches GLM-5.3 for cybersecurity
items.summary: Zhipu announced GLM-5.3, saying the model outperformed leading U.S. systems in cybersecurity benchmarks. The release reflects growing competition among Chinese model makers in security-focused AI.

items.title: AI token prices fall as US labs cut costs
items.summary: Industry pricing for frontier AI tokens has reportedly declined sharply since mid-July, with major labs lowering prices to stay competitive. The trend suggests intensifying pressure on model monetization and efficiency.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Netflix shuts down two game studios, including Night School Studio
items.summary: Netflix is closing two of its game studios, including Night School Studio, the developer behind Oxenfree and the title Unhinged. The move is one of the biggest industry developments in the latest gaming news cycle.

items.title: CD Projekt Red confirms layoffs at Project Sirius
items.summary: CD Projekt Red has confirmed layoffs affecting Project Sirius, its multiplayer Witcher spinoff. The news adds to broader concerns around the project’s development status.

items.title: Phantom Blade Zero to get gameplay deep dive at next State of Play
items.summary: Sony is set to feature a gameplay deep dive for Phantom Blade Zero at its next State of Play presentation. The announcement makes the action game one of the most notable upcoming showcase items.

items.title: Sony announces Marvel’s Wolverine PS5 bundle and accessories
items.summary: Sony has revealed a limited-edition Marvel’s Wolverine PS5 bundle along with matching accessories in a see-through design style. The announcement signals continued marketing push around the game’s release cycle.

items.title: Alan Wake 2 surpasses 3 million copies sold
items.summary: Remedy has confirmed that Alan Wake 2 has sold more than 3 million copies nearly three years after launch. The milestone is one of the clearest recent sales updates in the industry.

items.title: Sonic Frontiers tops 5 million copies sold
items.summary: SEGA has announced that Sonic Frontiers has now sold over 5 million copies. The sales figure makes it one of the more notable franchise updates reported today.

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day beta crosses 20,000 concurrent players on Steam
items.summary: GamingBolt reports that the Gears of War: E-Day beta has surpassed 20,000 concurrent players on Steam. The milestone stands out as a strong early signal of interest in the game.

items.title: Clawed launches today after building 260K wishlists
items.summary: The Aussie dinosaur stealth game Clawed has launched today, following a strong wishlist count of 260,000. It is one of the notable release-related stories in the current gaming coverage.
